stem: Represent graphically the function $f(x) = 0$. Drag the two points so the line is the graph.
solution: Plot these points on the square net.
Draw the straight line through them: it lies along the x-axis.

hints.text: Your line is parallel to the right one but at the wrong height. What is the image of every x?
Every x has the same image, so the points have different x but the same y. Does that give a vertical line?
Find f(-1), f(0), f(1) from the rule and compare them.
